facts.headline: 11 validation check codes in validator, plus 1 conflict check in pipeline
facts.detail: 11 row-level checks in backend/app/validate/validator.py cover date mismatches, parse faults, symbol boundaries, contract expiry windows, negative or non-positive prices, OHLC consistency, negative volume/OI, zero volume, duplicate rows, and pre-listing GOLDTEN dates. A 12th check (CONFLICTING_REVISION) runs separately in the import pipeline.

facts.headline: 74 passing tests
facts.detail: All 74 tests pass in the backend pytest suite across ingest, validation, normalization, liquidity, analytics, backtest, derived series, and pipeline stages.

facts.headline: Look-ahead tests pass
facts.detail: Look-ahead tests pass in backend/tests/test_analytics.py (test_lookahead_temporal_isolation) and backend/tests/test_backtest.py (test_lookahead_temporal_isolation). Rolling medians, MAD, robust z-scores, and trade execution dates are strictly backward-looking.

facts.headline: Append-only database ledger with audit triggers
facts.detail: Raw bhavcopy records and ingested trade rows cannot be overwritten or updated in place. Note on trigger limits: a database owner could remove the trigger; the hash chain plus an outside copy of the latest hash is the real evidence.

facts.headline: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining
facts.detail: Each import run hashes accepted rows and binds to the previous run's digest. Any retroactive row manipulation alters downstream hashes.

facts.headline: Held-out test window evaluation
facts.detail: Backtest strategy verdicts run strictly on chronological held-out segments. Look-ahead tests pass without cross-period parameter leakage.
